visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a close-up shot, a female character faces the camera wearing a festive red top with white fur lining, styled like a Christmas-themed Cheongsam. She wears a full-face motorcycle helmet decorated with colorful tropical floral patterns and a dark purple visor. She performs playful boxing movements, punching towards the lens with gloved hands. The background is a soft-focus outdoor path with red-leafed trees under a bright sky. (2) The shot transitions to a medium shot as the woman turns around and walks toward a white and pink Suzuki sportbike parked on a dirt path. She wears a short white skirt and high black leather boots. The setting is rural with green fields in the distance and a row of tall, thin trees lining the road. (3) From a low-angle perspective behind the motorcycle, the woman performs a high-leg stretch before swinging her leg over the seat to mount the vehicle. The bike has visible GSX-R decals. Sunlight filters through the trees, creating a warm, natural lighting environment. (4) The woman is shown riding the motorcycle through a residential area. She wears a small white backpack. Visual overlays appear on the screen, including a large yellow 'M' and then a glowing 'Merry Xmas' subtitle with animated stars, while she continues to drive forward toward a modern house in the background.
